_comment: Provisional (機動) duty cuts under Customs Act Art. 71, applied by build_duty_rates.py build_tw on every build. Each entry is one Ministry of Finance notice. A line names the printed scope: an 8-digit code covers every 11-digit leaf under it; a printed CCC code ('ccc') covers that one leaf only, never its siblings. column_1 / column_2 give [schedule rate, provisional rate] as the schedule xls words them; the xls must still print the schedule rate on every covered leaf, or the build stops. Column II is keyed by the origin group the xls prints; a group not listed keeps its rate. While a notice is in force at the build's snapshot date its rate IS the rate served (valid_from/valid_until), with the schedule rate as a scheduled row from the day after it ends; outside it the schedule rate is served. Every notice ends early if the tariff schedule is amended during the period (自動終止), which the base-rate check catches only for the lines listed.
_unresolved: 2304.00.90.10-8 (feed soybean-oil residues), Notice 台財關字第1151027003號: provisional rate 免稅. The annex footnotes the schedule rate as 3% under Chapter 23 Additional Note 1, while the xls prints 0%. Not listed here until that note has been read: a scheduled return to the xls 0% would assert an unverified rate.
_coverage: Not an inventory: only the notices listed here have been read (2026-11-19). Read from the Executive Yuan Gazette and the customs annexes; the portal's 機動稅率清表.xls is not acquired.
